feature: History questions follow the current search field

scenarios.name: Changed question revokes the old answer
scenarios.given: Ask is streaming retrieved excerpts for a saved budget conversation
scenarios.when: the user changes the History search field to Berlin
scenarios.then: the old consumer cancels, partial output clears, Ask can answer Berlin immediately, and a late old provider cannot overwrite its answer or citations; only Berlin excerpts reach the new provider

scenarios.name: Empty query cancels a hidden answer
scenarios.given: Ask is streaming and its answer is visible
scenarios.when: the user clears the History search field
scenarios.then: the old consumer cancels and its answer clears even though the Ask panel disappears; the next question can run without waiting for the old server

scenarios.name: Whitespace edits preserve the same question
scenarios.given: Ask is streaming an answer for budget
scenarios.when: the user adds only leading and trailing whitespace to the History query
scenarios.then: the same request and partial answer remain active and finish with their original citation
